Container.Name: homeboxmcp
Container.Overview:
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Homebox, the self-hosted home inventory. Exposes 16 tools over stateless streamable HTTP so an MCP client — Claude or any other — can search your inventory, create and move items and locations, manage tags, and attach receipts, manuals and photos in plain language.
Requires a running Homebox instance (v0.26.x, which unifies items and locations as "entities" and renames labels to "tags") and an API key or login for it.
Files are attached via a read-only inbox mount rather than inline base64: drop a file into the inbox share, then attach it by filename. Set MCP_AUTH_TOKEN if this container is reachable from anywhere other than your own LAN.
After starting, verify with: curl http://[IP]:[PORT:3334]/healthz
Container.Requires: A reachable Homebox v0.26.x instance and an API key (or email/password) for it.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port the MCP server listens on. Point your MCP client at http://[IP]:[PORT]/mcp

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Holds config.json. Leave the Homebox URL/API key variables blank if you configure via this file instead.

Config.Name: Inbox Directory
Config.Description: Read-only staging directory for files to attach. Drop receipts, manuals and photos here, then attach them by filename. Mounted read-only on purpose: the server never writes to or deletes from your share.

Config.Name: Homebox URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Homebox instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7745 — no trailing /api/v1. Leave blank if set in config.json.

Config.Name: Homebox API Key
Config.Description: API key for Homebox. Preferred over email/password. Leave blank if set in config.json.

Config.Name: MCP Auth Token
Config.Description: Bearer token required on every MCP request. STRONGLY recommended if this container is reachable beyond your LAN. Leave blank to disable authentication entirely.

Config.Name: Max Upload MB
Config.Description: Largest attachment accepted. Must match Homebox's own HBOX_WEB_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE, or uploads will fail at the Homebox end instead of being rejected here with a clear message.

Config.Name: MCP Path
Config.Description: Path the JSON-RPC endpoint is served on. Change only if something else needs /mcp.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: error, warn, info or debug. Use debug when diagnosing a client that will not connect.

Config.Name: Max Request Bytes
Config.Description: Largest accepted JSON-RPC request body, in bytes.

Config.Name: Entity Type Cache TTL (ms)
Config.Description: How long Homebox entity type IDs are cached. Default 24h. Set 0 to disable caching while debugging.

Config.Name: Homebox Email
Config.Description: Only if you are not using an API key. Requires the password variable too.

Config.Name: Homebox Password
Config.Description: Only if you are not using an API key.
